implementation.admission: Original exact source proof unchanged. Two ordered exits, fixed U32 descriptors, matching stores/reads, invariant limits, exact SSA carries and no extra effects/statements. Ordinary semantic, ownership, read, escape and backedge checks finish first.
implementation.guard: At least8 guaranteed steps from each source; nested source-source-destination owner/range/capacity/nonwrap proofs. Declines retain the exact checked instruction suffix. Short/empty/wrapped/out-of-bounds cases keep ordinary access and valid-prefix trap behavior. No header stride read: fixed scalar admission already proves four-byte layout.
implementation.pointer_induction: Only successful guards initialize private byte pointers. Fresh source loads precede each store, preserving aliases/ties. Restore actual first/second/output indices after exit. Guards prove nonwrapping final increments. No source observer can inspect intermediate scalar carries.
implementation.scalar_old_load: Plain terminal indexed scalar; address/owner/read/bounds and live borrow retained before RHS. Bounded Core walk admits constants, normalized local/parameter refs, scalar/logical and get/length, excludes self/captures/globals/calls/dispatch/unsupported forms. No incomplete liveness-map proof. Shape-only replacement clears old runtime/literal/capture data. Existing writer/store order retained.
implementation.counters: scoped_merge_loops, scoped_scalar_old_loads_avoided. Static emitter work; not exact final encoded-instruction or exclusive CPU counts.
implementation.publication: Detached body, transactional capacity reservation, checked fallback instruction equality and full allocation rollback; span/snapshot receipts reset.
implementation.astra_review: No blockers after read-only review of guards, access order, scalar omission, pointer nonwrap and exact final-cursor restoration.

method.cold_build: Fresh driver and compiler per sample; cache disabled. OS and installed-library caches retained. Source staging outside timer. Complete wall and native build phases retained.
method.runtime: Same Node/V8 and flags for both. test/run use official inputs/iterations/warmups. bounded retains production problem sizes with reduced counts recorded per case. Same state retained after warmup. Preparation, startup, engine compilation and output outside clock; no per-element host calls. Two Blot clock packet crossings versus two Goose scalar imports are part of their ABI costs. Common process wall includes parsing the Blot TypeScript guest host for both backends; it is not Goose's standalone runner startup score.
method.representation: Goose byte buffers use U8; Blot stores identical values in U32, 4x element payload bytes; owner and arena overhead are separate. Fixed backing capacities retained. Sort U32 values are nonnegative and preserve I32 ordering; ports restrict sizes to100000/400000, where exact integer RNG conversion matches every Goose F64 RNG state. Mandelbrot uses explicit ordered F32 in BOTH sources; original F64 remains unavailable. Fannkuch indices/permutations are nonnegative; U32 checksum wrap preserves final U32 accumulation. Wider parameter/clock plumbing stays outside kernels. Custom Hash::SHA256 is not cryptographic SHA-256.
method.ordering: Build phase sequential, then runtime phase; seeded paired shuffling, no deliberate concurrent measurement work.
